author: Sk_Winger
body:
I am deeply sorry that I was using kill aura on this server it is something I must admit but I didn't use it on anyone except for my friend, X_Slim, he knew that I was just messing with him. If you don't believe me then you can personally ask him. I was in the wrong place at the the wrong time as there happened to be a senior mod on the server (Fouled).  Therefore if you appeal my ban I promise to never use kill aura or any type of hack on your server again even if I'm just playing a joke on my friend. Please take this appeal into consideration and thank you in advance. 

You can also contact me by email: Juneyoung.yun25@gmail.com

title: Sk_Winger Appeal

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

Since you did admit to using kill aura, there seems to be no need to show you the evidence. Hacking on the server as a joke and for your own benefits is not allowed, no matter the circumstance. You must face the consequences for your actions.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in 5-7 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Fouled
